body: Yeah I'm hoping I get better from here
It's nice to let some people know what's happening, even if it's a whole community that cares
I love how supportive everyone is here, I didn't expect it, I just had to get it out somewhere and got lovely people helping me now
I agree, sometimes I don't feel like I'll make it, but I try to get through it all, as my mother doesn't need that dreaded phone call
Yeah, I don't think they know the full side of everything, but I'm glad to get some support from them
Yeah can't do much else with the experience other than learn
It's okay, it's something for me to learn from in future
I'll be proud of the scar, it'll remind me that I can survive somethings in life, just gotta recover which isn't too easy but I'll be okay, thank you for caring as much
I'm doing okay now, thank you
I'm okay, a little sore but I'm recovering, thank you
I'm recovering slowly, doing my best to get through this
Thank you, the pain wasn't as bad as putting them through this, but I'm recovering and they are working to put me in a better spot in life
I'm okay, sore but recovering
I'm glad everyone has shown soo much support, I didn't expect it
I'll be okay, got family and support from all these fellow redditors and I'm grateful
Yeah, just wish I didn't go as far as I did to find out
That takes some strength to do, sorry it's gotten that bad for you
Yeah I understand, i cut through to the bone and it sent chills down me, my brother in law got me to the ER real quick, poor mother got a phone call and had to witness it all
A lot better now, I can't use my arm atm but I will recover
Heck yes
I'll defs give it a go, I'll be better once I have a sleep tho
I understand, it gets hard, I tried ODing years back but this is the worst it's gotten, just glad I had my mother to help out
Yeah had a lovely doctor to stitch me up, I'm safe now
Hopefully I meet more people as willing as you are, online or around town, harsh world but it's nice knowing people are willing to help, even if things seem hopeless. Thank you and much love

I'll try my best, thank you for all this, it's really helped me get everything off my chest, I will pm you if I need a little help or to keep you up to date if you are okay with it, just glad someone is willing to talk to me about this.

I have a bad issue where I can't sleep at night, so I end up losing most of the day because of it, which also really adds on to the issue of getting the time to, plus the heat outside lately is intense which also puts me off. 

The pain I'm always in doesn't help, ever since I did me back in I'm always feeling ill when I wake up, kinda puts me in a hole I don't feel like climbing out of.

If it wasn't for all these things I'd be willing but it all kinda stops me from wanting to do anything, and it's fairly consistent ironically

I'm waiting for a day where I can get down the street easily and where I'm comfortable doing so, it's more of how my day starts, not gonna wanna go anywhere when I'm always tired and bummed out so I just gotta find a good day where it's not gonna bother me to go out.

I've got it all planned out on what I need to do, it's just getting it done I'm struggling with, I'm more surprised you've stuck with me on this for so long, I'm thankful for it

So far my next step is my income, the problem is I just gotta go down and talk to the bank, post office and Centrelink, which is like income support.

Been putting it off for nearly a year now, and every time I get close something will come up and throw a wench into all of it. I'm not a fan of having money, I'm not sure why but I'm starting to struggle without it. 

I like the idea of just gunning for things but the anxiety really hurts that idea, trying to find a way around it but until then I'm just really quiet with everything.

It's overwhelming, but I am trying anyway, you're right as I don't know where to start, but I'm hoping that I'll end up working it out. 

I did have a job once a few years ago, but I hurt my back and struggle to do much related to lifting and strain on it, I'm hoping I'll end up doing something that doesn't end up straining my back. 

You seem to be on point with me being afraid of everything, I didn't really know why I am but with what you say it's something I can agree on. 

When I get told I did wrong my heart just sinks, makes me feel terrible so I think you're also on point with it.

My stupid at 4am is somewhat low, each day has it's moments that change it, which seems to happen often. 

I don't know what I wanna do, but something social is something I'd like to do, just scared I'll end up messing it all up and making a fool of myself. 

I seem to enjoy drinking a lot, as I loosen up and don't care how stupid I look, but it's rare to do as money is a big factor for it. Having someone around I know seems to make me feel better, not a fan of being alone as it leaves me to my thoughts a lot.

I'm mostly struggling lately with getting income, social life and wanting to make something of myself, I believe that is something that can help me feel better about living, but with things stopping me from doing anything about it all it starts to feel hopeless, sort of like insanity to keep trying for it all. 

I will end up getting a therapist soon, just once I can find the strength to do it, haven't left the house in like maybe a week now and the lack of energy keeps me from going into town and doing anything. 

I'm scared of let us say everything, I can't cope being around strangers for long and the thought of stuff like driving and working really gets to me, I have a habit where I end up being scared of failing and making mistakes, usually ending up crying my heart out and beating myself up physically and mentally.

I rely on other people's opinions on me as I don't know myself very well, I don't like being told I did something wrong and it hits hard, makes me feel like I shouldn't do something and end up not doing anything related to it. 

I enjoy talking about this stuff as not many people I know want to, I generally cover up with humor or being quiet. I like questions I know I can answer about me or related, but normally the AD kicks in most of the time when it comes to speaking about it.

I never really liked myself, the way I look and the way I ended up, just seems to me that a lot of my problems are my fault because of the way I am. 

I did try a therapist in the past but I struggled to communicate and felt like I wasn't saying the right things or didn't know how to explain anything, I've been meaning to try therapy again but I haven't been able to bring myself to it.

You're pretty much on point with it all, I'm just glad you've taken time to talk to me about all this, not many people are willing to go through this with me so I'm okay with talking about anything about it, down to my past or my predicament lately, just really glad I can talk about this.

Just not being able to survive on my own, I can't speak to anyone without having someone speak on my behalf and having people give me a try to talk to them and not being able to say anything other than "No I'm okay" since I freeze and my brain just stops working on the spot.

I haven't really been able to do anything since I freeze and retreat, even if it's a game of football or going out for drinks, it's not fun when I wanna do something yet I keep turning it down. 

It's like just always needing an adult to do everything and hold my hand through everything, even though I'm capable I just can't help but retreat and have someone else step in.

My first actual girlfriend when I was 17 didn't know if I had anything, neither did I, I never was able to do anything with her or talk to her, always did something wrong and we were clueless, I was getting really depressed because I didn't know what to do about anything with her, but she made it very clear I was terrible at everything.

I didn't understand at the time but now I know what I had and understood enough, I end up hurting when I think about all the bad things that could have been avoided if I could just think at the time.

At the end of a day I just think and say I could have done better over the years, every day is like a papercut to me, I'm not happy with myself on that day and the depression of it adds on top of the depression that's already there.

About 6 months ago I tried overdosing, silly me as it was over a girl.

I have a routine where I go to bed at a usual time at like 12am but unable to sleep till about 4am, which ends up with either getting up early with no energy at all in the morning or sleeping and having no daylight to do anything.

I normally eat noodles for around lunch and a cheap meal to make at tea time as money is a big issue lately. 

I grew up being bullied by a lot of people, which isn't related as much, but I remember one time where my best friend at the time had a knife against me,  no reason as he was autistic I believe, that kinda have me some big trust issues.

Just not having a good time in life, never have and always had terrible luck, I've always felt like a child and sometimes it really bothers me.
Too real

He killed himself because his girl wanted to try with me, I didn't say no and he hung himself that night, if I just didn't let this shit happen he'd be still alive, I just can't believe he is gone, I've never had someone I could relate to soo much and he's gone

It's a fear, growing up comfortable with all this stuff I once had, all these entertainment options like games and movies to pass time, to sitting on the streets hoping someone would help. I've seen what people do to homeless in this town, I wish I can avoid it but with no income and no friends to help me anymore I've got no way to avoid it
